description: Defines the ue_manager class for managing UE contexts, configurations, dependencies, and related operations within the ocudu namespace, including methods for adding, removing, and querying UEs, as well as scheduling tasks.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts, configurations, dependencies, and asynchronous operations related to UEs within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: ue_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing ue_manager with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: get_ues
methods.description: Returns a constant reference to the internal UE database.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE based on provided configuration.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a specific UE identified by its index asynchronously.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to a UE context by its index.

methods.name: get_nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs currently managed.

methods.name: get_up_state
methods.description: Returns the current state of all UEs.

methods.name: schedule_ue_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a specific UE.

methods.name: get_next_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves the next available UE index.

methods.name: schedule_and_wait_ue_removal
methods.description: Schedules and waits for the removal of a UE.
